assets.name: Archivist
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one square game avatar, a single original fictional adult civilian portrait.
Subject: Archivist, an older woman with an angular gray bob, round spectacles and an ochre jacket, warm cream skin. Distinct expressive exaggerated face, no real-person likeness.
Style: Secret Hitler board-game illustration-inspired graphic 1930s printed caricature. Extremely simplified angular geometric face planes, emphatic slightly irregular charcoal ink contours, oversized characteristic nose and bold eyebrows. Flat opaque warm cream, mustard, terracotta, muted teal and charcoal shapes, maximum 5 main colors. Sparse expressive hatch marks ONLY. Graphic printed cut-paper/linocut appearance; broad deliberate shape design readable at 48 pixels. Flat solid face tones with at most one simple flat shadow shape, no gradients, no realistic shading, no detailed skin texture.
Composition: centered head-and-shoulders bust, very slight three-quarter angle toward the right, eyes looking toward viewer. Complete hair/hat, ears and both shoulders visible. Entire silhouette fits inside the central 84% of the square with at least 8% empty TRANSPARENT margin on all sides. Shoulder base finishes as a simple curved cutout and does not touch the canvas edges. Consistent avatar scale, no hands, no props.
Background: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT PNG alpha channel. All space outside the bust must have alpha=0. No background color or rectangle, no circle, no decorative backdrop, no halo, no shadow behind bust, no drawn checkerboard. Opaque character with crisp antialiased outline against genuine transparent empty space.
Avoid: photorealism, painterly brushwork, 3D rendering, portrait photography, realistic anatomy, smooth gradients, elaborate hatching, film grain, text, labels, letters, badges, logos, flags, political symbols, affiliations, extra characters, collage, grid or sprite sheet.
Output exactly one separate square transparent portrait.
